items.reason: Persistent PAPER state machine is ready; external broker mapping and live recovery are not implemented.
ACID PAPER outbox exists; no external transport dispatcher or reconcile-before-retry integration exists.
Local identities and manual unknown recovery exist; broker-side stable idempotency is unverified.
Atomic PAPER cash/sell reservations exist; production buying-power semantics are unverified.
Decimal replay and versioned T+2 fixture exist; official account semantics, fees, taxes and settlement calendars require verification.
Long-only exposure, turnover, cash, position and volume gates exist; production tradability and account gates are missing.
PAPER scheduler, lease, safe mode, heartbeat and persistent alerts exist; authenticated production transport and supervisor are missing.
Live gates and secret-free credential reference exist; secret backend/rotation/revocation are operator decisions.
Dashboard is local/read-only with no broker controls; no readiness control page was needed.
Official 1.7.6 metadata publishes Python >=3.7 and macOS 11 arm64 wheels; target-host runtime is untested.
SinoPac account, signatures, API test and Trading permission are required.
Official simulation uses API credentials and does not support odd-lot orders.
APIs are documented; failure/race semantics need controlled verification.
No official exactly-once or caller-controlled durable client-order-id guarantee was found.
Refresh and cache-health recovery exist; authoritative negative lookup and safe resubmit are unknown.
No comprehensive official versioned error-code catalog was found.

operator_decisions: Eligible cash-stock account and explicit exclusion of margin, short, SBL and day-trade-short
macOS Keychain versus approved secret manager, plus rotation/revocation ownership
Licensed market/reference-data provider and permitted retention/non-display/derived use
Deployment host, process isolation, authenticated control plane and network allowlist
Manual kill-switch owner, two-step live approval, staged-capital caps and rollback thresholds
next_implementation_order: Resolve official semantic unknowns and operator decisions without credentials where possible
Select and contract production data/market-data rights
Implement licensed production data adapters and PIT coverage gates
Implement secret resolver and authenticated read-only Shioaji capability probe
Implement Shioaji adapter behind BrokerSession with simulation-only credentialed verification
Run offline conformance, credentialed simulation verification and no-submit production shadow reconciliation
Design and independently approve deployment/control plane before any staged-capital proposal
